title: The tuff is too tall to fit under my  door.
text: The tuff is too tall to fit under my  door.. Color is perfect.  Only problem is that the thickness of the mat is so high that it won't fit under my door, not which to be more unhappy about - the matt or the door.!

product_metadata.title: Smiry Luxury Chenille Bath Rug, Extra Soft and Absorbent Shaggy Bathroom Mat Rugs, Machine Washable, Non-Slip Plush Carpet Runner for Tub, Shower, and Bath Room(36''x24'', Grey)
features: SUPER SOFT & COMFORTABLE: Smiry luxury bath rugs soft and comfortable to touch, offers exceptional comfort and support for your feet. Every time you step out of the shower or bathtub, you can enjoy superior comfort.

ULTRA-ABSORBENT: Smiry Bathroom mats are made of thousands of ultra-soft individual microfiber shags. The thick chenille fabric absorbs water quickly to help save your floors from dripping water while you're getting out of the bath, shower or getting ready by the sink; Moisture is trapped in the mat's 1.28'' deep piles, allowing the bath rug to dry quickly and cleanly.

ANTI-SKID BACKING: Non slip bottom features high quality mesh PVC material to prevent the mat from shifting and skidding, protecting you and family from any slipping in the bathroom. WARNING: Place mat on CLEAN DRY FLAT FLOOR ONLY. Water under rug can cause it to slip. Always keep bottom of rug dry.

MACHINE WASH AND DRY: Smiry bathroom rugs are easy to clean, and you can conveniently be thrown in any washing machine and gently tumble dry on low. Super soft microfiber material will not shrink or turn rough even after the wash, which will keep your rug same for very long time.

CREATE YOUR BATHROOM OASIS: With many different colors to choose from, our rugs can be used at bathroom, shower, tub-side, living room, bedroom, front of the sink, or at any place in your home where you want support and warmth on your toes, it could be a perfectly decoration for the whole family.
